about:
# AllQuest

Lightweight quest-giver tracker for the WoW Forever client (Interface 16001): `!` markers on the world map and
minimap for quests your character can pick up. Self-contained quest database, OpenMap-aware.

See `curseforge/description.md` for the feature list, `CHANGELOG.md` for versions and `NOTICE.md` for credits and licensing.

## Layout
- `Core.lua` settings, presets, slash commands - `Data.lua` + `Data/DB_*.lua` quest database and filtering
- `Pins.lua` world map markers - `Minimap.lua` minimap markers and button - `Options.lua` settings UI
- `Events.lua` holidays - `Learn.lua` learns unknown quests - `Tracker.lua` hides the Blizzard tracker
- `devtools/` the in-game export addon and `build_data.py`, which regenerate `Data/DB_*.lua` (not shipped)

## Refreshing the data
Run `/aqdump` in game with the export addon enabled, `/reload`, then
`python devtools/build_data.py <SavedVariables/AllQuestDump.lua> Data`.

## License
GPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE`, and `NOTICE.md` for the data's origin).

## API for other addons
`AllQuestAPI` (see the comment at the top of `API.lua`): `IsReady()`, `GetQuests(uiMapId)`, `GetNearest(limit, maxYards)`,
`IsHidden(questId)` and the callback `AllQuest_Refreshed` (`AllQuestAPI:RegisterCallback("AllQuest_Refreshed", fn)`).

# Changelog

## 1.0.3
- Quest data refreshed (build 70938): 5,270 quests, 2,556 giver spots.
- Questie: when it is installed, AllQuest switches off Questie's own available-quest "!" markers so they do not sit on top of
  ours (new option "Hide Questie's available-quest markers", on by default; untick it and Questie's setting is restored).
- Darkmoon Faire quests show while the Faire is on (Monday 4:00 realm time, 7 days), also on non-English clients.
- Holiday date windows use realm time (a one-day window such as Noblegarden is widened to a week). Non-English clients fall back to the built-in date windows.
- Learned quests: no duplicates once the data knows the giver, never shown to the other faction or to races/classes that
  cannot take them, repeatable ones stay, the first giver seen is kept, holiday ones expire a few days after that holiday's run, XP keeps the highest value seen.
- Warlock Dreadsteed chain quests ("must be active" prerequisites) can show again. Quests whose prerequisite Questie hides (removed or not yet out) stay hidden until the data is refreshed.
- Notices: no false "new quest" for repeatables, after a settings change, or after reputation/skill gains.
- Minimap: markers no longer stay hidden after the position is briefly unknown; safer with skins that change the minimap size.
- Public API version 4: `IsAvailable` returns `false, "hidden"` for quests you hid.
- Fix: the settings Export/Import box no longer cuts the text short.
- Quest list: search matches accented capitals (German, French, Spanish), waits for a pause in typing, and the list no longer re-sorts under the mouse; on narrow screens the window shrinks instead of clipping columns.
- Right-click menu on a marker offers "hide chain" for every quest at that giver that has one.
- Questie's profile switch or reset re-applies the hide option; the holiday calendar redraws only when something changed.
- Slash command output is translated (German, French, Spanish).

## 1.0.2
- Quest data refreshed: 4,650 quests, 2,274 giver spots, and rewards for most of them (XP for about 4,000 quests, money for about
  970, reward and choose-one items for about 1,800); anything missing fills in as you open quest windows.
- World map buttons: they now sit a little left of the corner (other addons' round buttons covered them), Alt-drag any of the
  three to move them (Alt-right-click on the AllQuest button, `/aq resetbuttons` or a button in the settings puts them back).
- Quest list: scope "Map I am viewing", Ctrl-click a row to show it on the map, "Show more" past 250 rows, and it remembers
  its scope, type filter and window position. Number columns show a dash where nothing is known; distances update in place
  instead of re-sorting the list every two seconds.
- New option: hide quests you cannot take yet (required level above yours). Notices no longer count those as new.
- Key bindings for the quest list, the markers and the settings (Game menu > Options > Key Bindings > AddOns).
- Drop-down menus show a tooltip for presets and close with Escape; the settings window remembers where you left it.
- Public API version 3: `IsAvailable`, `GetGivers`, `GetQuestInfo` and the `AllQuest_Hidden` callback.
- Chat messages, giver names ("NPC 123", "Dungeon: ...") and preset descriptions are translated (German, French, Spanish).
- Fix: the right-click menu in the quest list opens in front of the list; long menus (many hidden quests) scroll with the mouse wheel.
- Fix: rewards seen in game are only saved for the quest that is on screen, and a max-level character no longer overwrites the XP a lower level saw.
- Fix: changing a setting no longer makes the next level-up announce the quests the setting revealed; a quest with unknown rewards shows a dash, not "none".
- Fix: quests learned in game in a zone the data has no givers for now get their markers.
- Fix: a race missing from the data no longer hides every racial quest.
- Fix: the "another addon is steering the waypoint" check keeps working after your first click.
- Fix: markers no longer hang on to a hover tooltip after they are redrawn; fewer hitches from reputation and skill gains,
  settings clicks and the minimap markers while you stand still; several unknown quests in one gossip window give one chat line.

## 1.0.1
- Quest list is now a sortable table: Level, Quest, Giver, Zone, Distance, XP, Money and Rewards columns. Click a header
  to sort (click again to flip the direction); the Columns button switches columns on and off. Choices are remembered.
- Quest list: the sort menu lists every column, has an ascending / descending button, and unknown values sort last.
- Fix: drop-downs in the settings (presets, marker style, waypoints, restore, profiles) and the quest list showed nothing when
  clicked, because the game's menu opened behind the window. They now use AllQuest's own menu, which always opens on top.
- Quest list: a quest is listed once per giver (at the spot nearest you) instead of once per spawn or drop spot.
- Quest list: a gear button in the title bar opens the settings; the level column header is shortened to "Lvl".
- Public API (version 2): quests carry xp, money and reward item ids, and `AllQuestAPI.GetRewards(questId)` returns them.
- Hovering a reward icon in the quest list shows the game's own item tooltip (weapon, potion ...) instead of the quest panel.
- XP, money and reward items are learned from the quest windows you open in game (and shown in the row tooltip).
  The data export tool can also bundle them.

## 1.0.0 - first release
- Fix: the quest list and settings windows no longer blend when dragged over each other; clicking one brings it to the front.
- Everything from 0.x: markers on the world map and minimap, quest list, presets and profiles, hide lists, quest-type
  filter, waypoints that coexist with other arrow addons, display options, three languages, OpenMap support.

## 0.11.2
- Fix: the new-quest notice now waits a moment after a level-up or turn-in, so quests the game had not yet flagged as
  completed no longer hide the quests they unlock.
- Fix: the options and quest list windows open above the world map.
- CurseForge description refreshed.

## 0.11.1
- Waypoints work alongside Quest Pilot and TomTom: a click moves the arrow only when nothing else is using it
  (Shift-click always does); only one AllQuest waypoint exists at a time and it clears itself on arrival.
  The behaviour can be changed under Waypoints (smart / always move the arrow / mark the map only).
- Public API (`AllQuestAPI`) for other addons: available quests per map, nearest quests, hidden check, refresh callback.
- Settings window is wider, long labels wrap, and the profile / export / import buttons sit on their own lines.
- Quest data refreshed.

## 0.11.0
- Quest list window (`/aq list`, a button on the world map, middle-click on the minimap button): search, sort by
  level / name / distance / zone, filter by zone range and quest type, click a row for a waypoint.
- Chat notice when a level-up or a turned-in quest makes new quests available (can be switched off).
- The quest panel names the quest before and after in a chain (one line; can be switched off).
- Blacklist: hide a single quest, a quest and everything that follows it, a giver, or a whole zone; restore them one by one.
- Display options: marker shape (exclamation, diamond, round), dark outline, opacity, text size, quest panel size.
- Quest titles follow the client language when the game has them.
- More translated text (German, French, Spanish).

## 0.10.1
- Fix: a marker the map released on its own could stay invisible; it is drawn again now.
- Group sizes are also read with the older quest log API.
- New: Reset all settings button; the map and minimap button tooltips show how many quests are available in your zone.
- Pop-up texts are translated.

## 0.10.0
- Click a marker to set a waypoint (TomTom if installed, otherwise the game's map pin); right-click to hide a
  quest or a giver. Hidden items can be restored one by one or all at once in the options.
- Quest-type filter: a small button on the world map (and matching options) switches Group, Class, PvP, Raid,
  Heroic, Legendary, Escort and Profession quests, plus dungeon / dropped-item / repeatable / holiday quests, on and off.
- Profiles: every character can use its own settings profile. Settings can be exported and imported as text.
- Several givers on the same spot: the hover panel cycles through them.
- Group quests show the suggested group size when known (learned from your quest log; the data export can add more).
- Optional zoom safeguard for OpenMap: far markers are hidden while zooming only if the frame rate drops.
- `/aq status` shows the profile, preset and the age of the quest data; a one-time notice appears after a game patch.
- Translations: German, French and Spanish (first drafts).
- `/aq profile [name]`, `/aq restore`.

## 0.9.0 - first public beta
- Quest-giver markers on the world map and minimap, filtered for your character (level, race, class, completed
  quests, prerequisites, profession skill, reputation, holidays).
- Dungeon quests shown at the dungeon entrance; dropped-item quests shown where the item drops.
- Difficulty colours matching the game's scale, colour-blind palette, optional +/- level numbers,
  quest-type letters (Class, Dungeon, Event, Group, Heroic, Item, Legendary, PvP, Raid, Escort, Profession).
- Hover panel with giver, type, requirements and what drops an item; minimal or detailed.
- Presets (Minimal, Detailed, Show All) plus your own named presets; Advanced section for every option.
- "Only my current zone" mode; OpenMap support (whole-continent markers while zoomed in).
- Minimap button, optional hiding of Blizzard's objective tracker, learns quests missing from its database.
